name: vstar_bench_lmms_eval
description: Evaluation dataset for large multimodal models assessing visual understanding and reasoning capabilities when answering image-grounded queries. Contains instances designed to probe LMMs' ability to interpret images, follow multimodal instructions, and produce accurate textual responses.
reputation: A community dataset hosted on Hugging Face for benchmarking LMMs; modest adoption primarily among researchers evaluating multimodal reasoning.
